name: pavia-lebanon
description: Pavia Lebanon static storefront and Firebase backend tooling.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check js/app.js && node --check js/admin.js && node --check js/backend.js && node --check js/backend-config.js && node --check js/backend-firebase.js && node --check js/firebase-config.js && node --check js/config.js && node --check js/image-catalog.js && node --check js/products.js && node --check admin/dashboard.js && node --check admin/payload.js && node --check service-worker.js && node --check scripts/build-pages-artifact.mjs && node --check scripts/check-pages-artifact.mjs && node --check scripts/encrypt-admin.mjs && node --check scripts/seed-rtdb.mjs && node --check scripts/firebase-emulator-smoke.mjs
scripts.emulators: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-firebase.ps1 emulators:start --only auth,database --project demo-pavia-local
scripts.emulators:import: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-firebase.ps1 emulators:start --only auth,database --project demo-pavia-local --import=.firebase/emulator-data --export-on-exit=.firebase/emulator-data
